specs.delivery_status: PARTIAL — environment/VFX complete, enemy sets incomplete; do not mark stage-2 art done
specs.mounted_frame: 640x512 anchor (320,490), 360px total visible standing height. All mounted states must retain these dimensions and anchor.
specs.pipeline: First-party native Grok generation. sprite-gen workflow says local Grok credential missing/expired/unreadable, so no batch animation generation was run. Native video throw retained; sprite-gen extraction and one-shot cut retained. Automatic video-loop once cut selected the opening idle, not the throw; retained for comparison. Recut through video-loop fixed (start 42, length 97). Manual nonuniform sampling + scale/feet registration documented in alignment.json. Full batch motion generation still requires restored CLI access.
specs.build_order: finalize.py -> p27_assets.py -> existing stage-1 docs/preview/verify -> stage2_build.py -> stage2_verify.py. finalize.py wipes art/, so keep generated sources in art_src/stage2 and run stage2 build last.
specs.integration: This sub-manifest is separate, frames are relative to art/stage2/. Prefix each frame/sheet by stage2/ when merging into art/manifest.json. No game code or stage-1 manifest changed.
